lessons.title: Question: Importing React
lessons.interactiveContent:
Welche Anweisung importiert React in unsere App?

import React from "react"import "react"import from "react"

import React from "react".
lessons.hardModeContent:
Du schreibst import { React } from "react", brauchst aber den Standardexport des Pakets als React.

Welcher Ersatz korrigiert den Import?

import React from "react"import "react"import from "react"import { React } from "react"

Wähle import React from "react" aus.
